meta.title: 2-Day Cat Ba Island Adventure from Hanoi | Trekking, Caves & Hidden Beaches
meta.description:
Escape Hanoi and join us in an exciting 2-day journey to Cat Ba Island! Trek through Kim Giao Forest and conquer Ngu Lam Summit for breathtaking panoramic views. Explore the mysterious Trung Trang Cave and step back in time at Cannon Fort, a historic war relic offering stunning seaside vistas.

Wake up to fresh sea air and take a peaceful morning walk along the hidden coastal paths connecting Cat Co 1 & Cat Co 2 beaches before heading back to Hanoi.

🔹 Day 1: Hanoi ➝ Cat Ba Island | Kim Giao Forest | Ngu Lam Summit | Trung Trang Cave | Cannon Fort | Overnight in Cat Ba
🔹 Day 2: Coastal Walk | Hidden Paths | Return to Hanoi

Perfect for nature lovers & adventure seekers!
